meaning.en: The definition of B/O is a bookkeeping abbreviation for brought over.

meaning.en: The definition of BO is an abbreviation for body odor, which is an unpleasant smell a person can have if he doesn't wear enough deodorant.

sentences.en: The speech has usually four parts-introduction (Or pool, µcov), narrative of facts (bo yrlacs), proofs (irivrecs), which may be either external, as from witnesses, or internal, derived from argument on the facts, and, lastly, conclusion (briXoyos).
sentences.vi: Bài phát biểu thường có bốn phần giới thiệu (Hoặc nhóm, µcov), tường thuật sự kiện (bo yrlacs), bằng chứng (irivrecs), có thể là bên ngoài, như từ nhân chứng hoặc nội bộ, bắt nguồn từ lập luận về sự kiện và, cuối cùng, kết luận (briXoyos).

sentences.en: The story is the one of chief importance to the Buddhists - the story, namely, of how the Buddha won, under the Bo Tree, the victory over ignorance, and attained to the Sambodhi, "the higher wisdom," of Nirvana.
